scoring_policy: Judge supported meaning and applicability, not length, citation counts, agreement, or token copying. Unknown user data may remain unknown; available mechanism research must still be done.

axes.name: material_original_obligations
criteria: Authoring/import-review/distribution flow for pages, diagrams and exercises; offline reading and topic search.
Local progress/update separation and truthful treatment of materially changed exercises and retired versions.
Keyboard reading/navigation/order, meaningful diagram alternatives and printable/offline export fidelity.
Explicit import loss and print/interactive differences, policy decisions and phased adoption.
negative_constraints: No images-of-text substitute for accessible instructions.
Updates cannot silently erase progress or overclaim changed-exercise completion.
No publication, volunteer installation or actual-learning-record processing.

axes.name: consequential_source_facts_and_applicability
criteria: Check consequential mechanisms against relevant primary context, including platform/version and caller or integration boundaries.
Separate documented guarantees from assumptions and limits.

axes.name: useful_unfamiliar_discovery_alternatives_history
criteria: Investigate accessible reading order, format fidelity and version/progress alternatives.
axes.recall_limit: Observed finite comparison set only; no universal recall claim.

axes.name: valid_corrections_rejections_plan_dispositions
criteria: After reveal, disposition each material draft choice as retained, changed, rejected, or unresolved with consequential support.
Do not silently discard requested behavior when correcting a draft assumption.

axes.name: supported_meaning_retained_to_complete_final
criteria: Preserve all material requirements and justified findings from discovery, draft and criticism in the complete final.
Keep alternatives, exceptions, negative constraints and uncertainty visible where they affect decisions.

axes.name: meaningful_validation_with_execution_distinguished
criteria: Propose interrupted update, progress migration, material exercise revision and retired search checks.
Propose paste-loss review and separate keyboard/screen-reader/print validation with outcomes not invented.
Identify which checks were executed, what they observed and their limits; label all unexecuted checks as proposed.
Research-proposal scope does not require deployment, physical intervention or proof of all possible behavior.

time_contract.wording: Complete all substantive research and planning obligations within a maximum of 60 elapsed minutes. Finish earlier when the complete output is ready. There is no minimum research duration, no requirement to consume the allowance, and no credit for waiting. The deadline includes arm-specific setup, provider queueing after admission, tools, native retries, handoffs, revision and delivery. Output quality is assessed independently of elapsed time.

global_negative_constraints: Do not deploy the future product.
Do not write canonical product specifications.
Do not preselect a winning product.
Do not expose this rubric or exact draft plan during brief-only discovery.
